scripts.dev: mkdir -p .scratch-books && npm run build -w @bbartolome/scriba-contracts && npm run build -w @bbartolome/scriba-api && concurrently -k -n api-tsc,api,web,contracts-tsc "tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node --watch apps/api/dist/main.js" "npm run start -w @bbartolome/scriba-web" "tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput"
scripts.e2e: npm run build -w @bbartolome/scriba-contracts -w @bbartolome/scriba-api && npm run e2e -w @bbartolome/scriba-e2e
